transcript.text: From what you have described, the most likely cause is clock/timer set to AUTO - set to MANUAL (free fix). On the clock, is there an AUTO/A showing - can you switch it to the MANUAL (hand) symbol and set the time?
display is flashing 0.00 and a little symbol. how do i set the time? no manual

The exact buttons vary by make, but on most ovens you press and hold the clock or hand-symbol button (or press the + and – buttons together) until the display flashes, then use + and – or the control knob to set the time. It usually saves itself after a few seconds, and on many models the hand symbol then lights to show the oven is in manual. Next: Set the clock/timer to MANUAL (hand symbol) and the correct time first. Let me know what you find.
ok which buttons though? its a neff. ive no idea what the model is

The exact buttons depend on your Neff's model and control type, which we don't know yet. On many Neff ovens you press the clock button (or the button with a hand symbol), then set the time with the + and − buttons or the control knob and wait a few seconds for it to lock in. Once it's in manual with the time set, does the oven heat?
ok i pressed the clock button and set the time with the + and - and it came on and is heating now. why did it do that?
Good news, that has sorted it. If it happens again, start with the same check. Is there anything else I can help with?
why did it do that though?
